title: M006f accepted-event replay adapter
hypothesis: Formally accepted M006e evidence can be transformed into deterministic M006f replay primitives without network access, broker capability, fabricated market prices, or modification of the frozen trading stack.
result: PASS: 3 accepted sessions and 17 authoritative events were verified. The corpus contains one bridge-approved USDJPY round trip, but exact historical bid/ask evidence was not persisted, so 0 simulator events were emitted. Five fail-closed adapter tests passed.
